name: research
description: Research-workflow skills for Chronicle — synthesis, results evaluation, literature review, and paper authoring, with the researcher as the approval gate.

interface.shortDescription: Research workflows over the Chronicle platform.
interface.longDescription: Multi-step research practices that compose the chronicle plugin's mechanics, driven by your own agent with you as the approval gate: synthesis (ground in the experiment record + literature, then propose and queue what to try next with pre-registered hypotheses), evaluate-results (judge runs against what they pre-registered; optionally persist findings, lessons, and review-gated reports), literature-review (survey the internal corpus + external literature, register and cite what matters), and paper-authoring (author a LaTeX paper locally and attach it so Chronicle compiles and records it). Requires the chronicle plugin from the same marketplace.
defaultPrompt: Run a synthesis pass on my experiment and propose what to try next.
Evaluate my experiment's results against their pre-registered hypotheses.
Draft a LaTeX paper from my experiment's record.
